overview_description.description:
SimpleLegal operates as a Software-as-a-Service company that develops an enterprise-level legal operations software platform for in-house counsel and corporate legal departments. It offers its platform for matter management; spend management; vendor management; knowledge management; reporting and analytics; and integrations. 

Nathan Werzel and Patrik Outericky founded Orthoprocess in 2013 that later became SimpleLegal. It has its headquarters in Mountain View in California.

about_short_description.short_description: SimpleLegal develops an enterprise-level legal operations software platform for in-house counsel and corporate legal departments.

product.name: e-Billing
product.description: A software solution that provides visibility into legal spend and streamlines the invoice processing workflow for legal departments.

product.name: Matter Management
product.description: A tool to track and manage the lifecycle of legal matters, including related documents, tasks, and case details.

product.name: Vendor Management
product.description: A system to evaluate and manage law firm and vendor performance using data-driven insights.

product.name: Reporting & Analytics
product.description: A reporting platform that provides comprehensive insights into legal spend, operations, and vendor performance for strategic decision-making.

product.name: Legal Requests
product.description: A feature that streamlines the intake and management of legal service requests from internal departments.
